name: Imperial Recreation Ground
summary: A large open ground by the seafront, big enough for a festival.
description: One of Exmouth's largest and most accessible open spaces, the Imperial Recreation Ground sits right by the seafront and the train station, with two of the town's biggest pay-and-display car parks next door. Toilets, water and an electricity hook-up are all available on request, which is why it is the go-to spot for the town's bigger outdoor events — festivals, fun days and fetes.
